description: This file manages shared state and HTTP routing for Mattermost slash commands, including per-account command registration, token validation, and route registration.

methods.name: resolveSlashHandlerForToken
methods.description: Resolves the handler and account IDs associated with a given command token, returning 'none', 'single', or 'ambiguous' match types.

methods.name: getSlashCommandState
methods.description: Retrieves the slash command state for a specific account ID.

methods.name: getAllSlashCommandStates
methods.description: Returns a read-only map of all active slash command states.

methods.name: activateSlashCommands
methods.description: Activates slash commands for an account, setting up command tokens, registered commands, and HTTP handler.

methods.name: deactivateSlashCommands
methods.description: Deactivates slash commands for a specific account or all accounts, cleaning up state.

methods.name: registerSlashCommandRoute
methods.description: Registers HTTP routes for slash command callbacks, handling multi-account routing and token validation.
